title: Unmarked Blackhawks during NOTAM experiments

tellings.quote: I mean, when you have Blackhawk helicopters, unmarked Blackhawk helicopters showing up in the middle of the night,

plain: While experiments were running at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for reports of strange events, unmarked Black Hawk military helicopters showed up in the middle of the night. The experiments were run under notices to pilots, the official alerts that warn aircraft away from an area. The ranch's owner, who says he saw it himself, tells Michels about "unmarked Blackhawk helicopters showing up in the middle of the night," which would suggest someone with government resources was watching the work.
